QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] That Which Lurks in the Forest
QuestInfo.0: Sheriff Lita is glad to have more people around to spread out the workload. She tells you to talk to Corine, who's well-informed about what's going on outside the city.
QuestInfo.1: Sheriff Lita is glad to have more people around to spread out the workload. She tells you to talk to Corine, who's well-informed about what's going on outside the city.
QuestInfo.2: Corine said the forest is overrun with the spirits of those who died in the great war a thousand years ago. She also said she has friends currently stationed in the forest... Go there and see if you can find them.

npc.0: You should go meet Corine first! She seems pretty well-informed about what's going on outside the city.
